notes.title: PvP Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We have now launched the PvP update with the following changes. We believe this will lead to more participation in PvP and more matches played.

[b]Changes:[/b]
- Up to 500 players will receive a Flux reward.
- We have removed negative rating points.

[b]Rewards:[/b]
1. 1000 Flux
2. 800 Flux
3. 600 Flux
4-10. 400 Flux
11-50. 300 Flux
51-100. 250 Flux
101-150. 200 Flux
151-250. 150 Flux
250-500. 100 Flux

[b]Requirements:[/b]
You need more than 1000 rating points to qualify for any rewards.

[b]Rating:[/b]
Reward per game: 0-50 points

[b]Domination (dom):[/b]
Winning a match: 25 points
Base capture: 10 points
Defending a base: 10 points
No deaths: 3 points
3 killing sprees: 3 points
10 killing sprees: 3 points
Prevention of killing spree: 3 points

[b]Death Match (dm):[/b]
First place: 30 points
Second place: 25 points
Third place: 20 points
No deaths: 10 points
3 killing sprees: 5 points
10 killing sprees: 5 points
Prevention of killing spree: 3 points

[b]Penalties:[/b]
Leaving the game: -50 points
Being afk: -50 points

[b]Other Changes:[/b]
- Nexar bombs were missing a detonate other explosives trigger.

[b]Future Stuff:[/b]
- Three new player ships.
- Vorsran balance patch.
- Three Emperors.

notes.title: PvP Changes Coming!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We are going to change how PvP ladder and rewards works significantly. For a long time the PvP system has been very competitive, but less inviting for players who are not the top 10 or have godly artefacts. Participation has been key here, and since we have very few players online the elo-rating and match making didn't work as intended and was mostly annoying for those with anything but the best. The reward for playing was not near enough, so many players simply opted out from PvP matches.

We plan to release this on 1st of December, if not something unforeseen happens.

[b]Changes:[/b]
- Up to 500 players will receive a Flux reward.
- We have removed negative rating points.

1. 1000 Flux
2. 800 Flux
3. 600 Flux
4-10. 400 Flux
11-50. 300 Flux
51-100. 250 Flux

151-250. 150 Flux
250-500. 100 Flux

[b]Requirements:[/b]
You need more than 1000 rating points to qualify for any rewards.

[b]Rating:[/b]
Reward per game: 0-50 points

[b]Penalties:[/b]

- Improved disconnect logging, for better bug tracking.

notes.title: Balance Patch
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

For weeks we have been working to balance the game and finally we are ready for launching the update. Of course there are still work to be done and we know this update will not be the final one.

The weapon balance is based on a combination of user feed back and statistics. For example.. a weapon that people consider slightly OP but which is hardly used and is performing poorly in the statistics won't be nerfed. We also try to avoid nerfs that will render a weapon useless.

As for ship balance the main theme have been to give all skin a unique strong point. For example: 
- Judicator -> Best shield-regen in game
- Nexar Fighter -> Fastest ship around
- Spy-1 -> Strong kinetic single damage, useless with multi type weapons
- Assassin -> High speed and stealth, but squishy
- Nexar Blade -> Very strong in-fighter, but useless at everything else

[b]New Mini Bosses[/b]
Scrap Collector lvl 18
Ant lvl 12
Sax lvl 8
Hattur lvl 4 

[b]Group XP[/b]
A slight change to group XP will prevent obvious abuse, but at the same time promote and give bonus XP to groups who are even. You will gain 1% extra per party member.

[b]Spawn Times[/b]
We introduced an initial spawn time on certain spawners and reduced reset and rebuild time to promote those who don't refresh the instance.

notes.title: Crew Changes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We have some great news. For a long time crew training has been a pain for both new and old players, it was unforgiving and could easily make the player feel cheated, or give up on the entire crew. Therefore we have decided to remove crew training and replace it by giving out skill points during artefact upgrades instead.

The crew member will now gain 1-20 skill points depending on artefact strength.

This will hopefully speed up and make crew training more relevant.

Happy training!

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello folks!

We have been working on a few fixes:

- Fixed severe issue where beam weapons could glitch and crash/freeze the game. Most noticable on Laser Gatling but could also occur with tractor beam. 

- Optimized performance on upgrade station for players with a lot of weapons.

- Fixed more crash issues related to the latest Adobe Player version 23. (browser specific)

Have fun!
